findings: No original arithmetic or assignment was replaced by the patch; diagnostic before/after copies and separate metadata COMMON/helper records observe the existing operations.

GNUdbl layout matches the reader: 8-character magic, 19 INTEGER*8 and five REAL*8 values yield a 200-byte snapshot header; 15 INTEGER*8 and 22 REAL*8 values yield a 304-byte term record. Snapshot R3 arrays are separate records with four-byte Fortran record markers.
LNCOR1 metadata is saved after SP and SPPSP formation. The analyzer reconstructs SP=SUI*(1+GI*PAVP2) and SPPSP=((SUI*YI)*PAVP0)/SP with the source association, and checks metadata line identity.

Base STRF3*F3 and coupling (STRF3*F3)*ZF3L use the captured actual operands. Before/after and checkpoint chains are bitwise checks; fsum grouped contributions are descriptive accounting rather than an alternative pass threshold.
PANEL advances VFT by (NLIM1-1)*DV and shifts R3 by NLIM3-1 before zeroing the tail. The stage127 full-array carry check and stage110 same-origin resumption agree with the source indexing.
Separate stages120/121,122/123 and124/125 isolate optional XSECTM, LBLF4 XINT and continuum XINT checkpoint changes without claiming molecular or counterfactual accuracy.

The planned reader also authenticates inherited PANEL trace bytes, all 45 saved spectra/panel headers and permits only the identified runtime-clock header word exception. This is a future runtime check, not a result established by this static review.
nonblocking_limits: The fixed-case reader is tied to layer21, the 666.1–666.7 cm-1 term window and four selected R3 indices. It is not a generic trace protocol validator.

Consecutive sequence numbers and update/checkpoint chains are checked, but a complete arbitrary-file stage grammar is not independently enforced. Source-generated records and exact pinned instrumentation define the reviewed case.

Existing negative optical-depth physical failures remain open. Exact accounting/noninterference cannot establish line-data accuracy, isolate GI-only/YI-only causes, or attribute the WRF4/37 flux residual.
Archived input coefficients and full numeric traces remain private; no permission or new execution flow is introduced by this receipt.
